title: W6 demand_era fold routed only the director through the era row; five other demand-row readers still bind by era number
location: core/demand.odin:55-59 (the fold) vs core/crisis.odin:335-337, core/health.odin:114-117, core/warnings.odin:238-239, app/render/forecast.odin:77-78, app/render/crisis.odin:97-98
detail: The fold's own comment cites the divergent row (era 4 binds demand_era 3). At such an era the director spawns row-3 demand/set-pieces while crisis_evaluate, surge_active, forecast, and two renderers silently no-op or read nothing — split-brain binding, latent for full-game content.
recommended_fix: Hoist one helper (era row -> demand row, e.g. era_demand_row(cat, era)) beside era_row and route all six readers through it; keeps the binding single-sourced when demand_era != era.

title: W6 fixture fold duplicated the era table: era_test_catalog rebuilds rows 1-3 that test_catalog now carries, replacing (and leaking) the shared rows
evidence:
core/determinism_test.odin:164 + 192-194 (the W6 fold):
	cat.eras = make([dynamic]Era_Row, 0, 4, allocator)
	...
	make_era_row(cat, 1, "foundations", "Foundations (ARPANET)", 1, {ei2}, {res2, rt2}, {na2, std2}, allocator)
	make_era_row(cat, 2, "email_web", "Email & Web", 2, {ei2}, {res2, rt2, sb2}, {na2, std2}, allocator)
	make_era_row(cat, 3, "streaming_surge", "The Streaming Surge", 3, {ei2, si2}, {res2, rt2, sb2, ch2, cp2, rm2, rh2}, {na2, std2, wd2}, allocator)

core/era_test.odin:32 + 48-51 (untouched by the diff):
	cat.eras = make([dynamic]Era_Row, 0, 4, allocator)
	...
	make_row(cat, 1, "foundations", "Foundations", 1, {ei}, {res, rt}, {na, std})
	make_row(cat, 2, "email_web", "Email & Web", 2, {ei}, {res, rt, sb}, {na, std})
	make_row(cat, 3, "streaming_surge", "The Streaming Surge", 3, {ei, si}, {res, rt, sb, ch, cp, rm, rh}, {na, std, wd})
	make_row(cat, 4, "real_time", "Real-Time", 3, {ei, si}, {res, rt, sb, ch, cp, rm, rh}, {na, std, wd})
detail: Two hand-mirrored copies of eras.json rows 1-3 now exist in fixtures that must stay in sync. era_test_catalog's `cat.eras = make(...)` replaces test_catalog's populated table, leaking its 10 allocations — odin test's tracker confirms: `+++ leak 672B @ ... [determinism_test.odin:164:test_catalog()]` plus per-row sub-arrays.
recommended_fix: Simplify era_test_catalog to append only its era-4 row onto test_catalog's table (delete its rows 1-3 rebuild), or hoist one shared make_era_rows helper both fixtures call.

title: Drift-check B2 fix re-calls log_path instead of stabilizing the path lifetime; the implicit temp-arena contract stays a trap
detail: replay_hashes still accepts temp-allocated paths that die at its first per-tick free_all — the constraint lives only in comments at two call sites. A third flip class reusing a pre-computed path silently re-creates the vacuous-pass bug.
recommended_fix: Stabilize the lifetime instead: clone the path to context.allocator at the flip sites (or give log_path an allocator parameter), keeping the re-sim honest by construction rather than by comment.
